description: List incidents across providers, the most recently updated first. By default only incidents that are open now. Narrow it with providers, category, and a minimum impact; set state to recent to add incidents resolved in the last days. When the server URL sets filters, they apply to each argument you do not give.

impact.description: Minimum impact: partial_outage keeps partial and major outages

providers.description: Provider ids or names, for example github, vercel

state.description: active: open now. recent: everything updated in the last days.

name: list_feed
title: List provider incidents
